item.title: Dunkin’ Is No Longer for People Like Me and Ben Affleck
item.description: The odd new drinks of a beloved coffee chain reveal a lot about how the attention economy works.

item.title: Can We Kick a Woman Out of Our Mahjong Group Because She Plays Too Slowly?

item.title: In ‘9 to 5,’ Dolly Parton Put a Friendly Face on Feminism

item.description: A ruling on a parking lot dispute.

item.title: Ina Garten Says You Can Either Get on Her Train or Get Out of the Way
item.description: At 78, the cookbook author and Food Network host knows what she likes, knows what she wants and isn’t stopping anytime soon.

item.title: My Estranged Husband Is a Hoarder. Can I Force Him to Get Help?
item.description: We think the house would most likely be condemned if county inspectors ever got inside.

item.title: He Was a Top Lawn Care Influencer on YouTube. Then Everything Went Haywire.

item.title: Can Andre Agassi Enjoy Pickleball More Than He Hated Tennis?
